title: Diet-induced obesity murine model
author: Bianca Hemmeryckx
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kbacsie
materials: Process the portions for histology (see separate protocol).

steps.title: Randomize mice into groups
steps.instruction: Randomize 8‑week‑old male mice (C57BL/6J, C57BL/6N or gene‑deficient strains with control littermates) into two groups based on body weight.

steps.title: Assign diets and feeding schedule
steps.instruction: Give one group 7 g per mouse per day of standard chow (SFD, 10.9 kJ g⁻¹; ssniff® EF R/M acc. TD88137 mod, Catalog #E15721-34) and the other group 7 g per mouse per day of western high‑fat diet (HFD, 22 kJ g⁻¹; 42 % kcal from fat, 43 % from carbohydrates, 15 % from protein; same catalog reference). Provide drinking water ad libitum; note that average food intake is ~4 g day⁻¹, so animals remain on ad libitum feeding.

steps.title: House mice under controlled conditions
steps.instruction: Keep animals in a room at 20–23 °C and 30–40 % humidity with a 12‑hour light/dark cycle (lights on 7 AM, off 7 PM). For cages containing HFD‑fed mice, place 1–2 small wooden sticks to promote proper tooth wear.

steps.title: Replace diet and record metrics weekly
steps.instruction: Replace each diet weekly; record food intake and body weight each week.

steps.title: Fast mice before testing
steps.instruction: After 15 weeks of diet administration, fast the animals for 6 hours (7:30 AM – 1:30 PM).

steps.title: Measure blood glucose
steps.instruction: Take a drop of blood from the nicked tail of a free‑moving mouse and determine glucose using an Accu‑Chek Aviva meter with Accu‑Chek Aviva glucose strips (Catalog #06453970).

steps.title: Euthanize mice with anesthetic injection
steps.instruction: Inject mice intraperitoneally with either 60 mg kg⁻¹ sodium pentobarbital (Nembutal) or Dolethal. Prepare Nembutal (60 mg ml⁻¹) as a 10× dilution with saline; prepare Dolethal (200 mg ml⁻¹) as a 30× dilution with saline.

steps.title: Collect retro‑orbital blood for plasma
steps.instruction: When the animal is deeply anesthetized, collect blood from the retro‑orbital sinus into trisodium citrate, process for plasma, aliquot, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Perfuse circulatory system with saline
steps.instruction: Immobilize the animal, open the chest, insert a perfusion needle (Microflex Infusion set, orange, Catalog #240.05) into the left‑ventricle apex, and wash out the heart and entire circulatory system with saline. Make a small incision in the right atrium to allow outflow.

steps.title: Dissect subcutaneous white adipose tissue
steps.instruction: Make a midline skin incision at the level of the hind limbs, pull the skin laterally to expose inguinal subcutaneous white adipose tissue (sWAT), remove internal lymph nodes, and dissect out the sWAT depots.

steps.title: Open abdominal cavity and collect organs
steps.instruction: Make a midline incision in the muscle layer to open the abdominal cavity, locate intra‑abdominal gonadal (GON) WAT depots and liver, and remove them.

steps.title: Remove interscapular brown adipose tissue
steps.instruction: Flip the mouse, locate the interscapular brown adipose tissue depot, and excise it.

steps.title: Portion tissues for downstream analyses
steps.instruction: Divide each harvested tissue into portions appropriate for RNA extraction, protein extraction, or histology.

steps.title: Snap‑freeze tissue samples
steps.instruction: Snap‑freeze the portions destined for RNA and protein extraction and store them at –80 °C.

steps.title: Clean equipment and bench
steps.instruction: Clean all dissection tools and the bench using Virkon S (5 O tablets/bottle, Fisher Scientific Catalog #NC9821357), detergent, water, and 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Dispose of carcasses per guidelines
steps.instruction: Dispose of the animal bodies according to internal institutional guidelines.

steps.title: Maintain cages and monitor health
steps.instruction: Replace drinking water and change cages weekly; check animal health daily.
